changelog:
Initial release of erxes skill.

- Enables managing contacts, companies, products, tags, documents, brands, automations, team members, organization data, and plugin records on an erxes instance via GraphQL.
- Includes browser-based login with token handling—no tokens stored in project files.
- Safe action and confirmation rules for risky mutations (create, delete, convert, etc.).
- Supports search, filter, group, and summarize features for main entities.
- Provides fallback and follow-up workflows, including record lookup by name and minimum info prompts.
- Mongolian-language action lists included for contacts, products, tags, brand, documents, team, structure, and plugin functionalities.
